system.summary: Pool of many keys. Family C (R5518 etc.): homophonic substitution, about 36 signs (numerals, crosses, letter shapes), about two signs per vowel, Italian. R5482: a code.
system.notes: Dots distinguish sign variants; the 115 key sheets of the box are 19th-century reconstructions and none was matched.

prior_solution.where: Not yet searched beyond the catalogue vetting (no published readings found, 28 Oct 2026).

conditions.human_role: The user asked to solve catalogue 1311.

solution.what: Fetched all 203 DECODE records of cart. 1598/1591 (110 letters, 93 key sheets).
Contact-sheet triage of the 133 letter pages; R5482 viewed at 150 dpi. Finding: many sign families and hands, at least one code (letter+number groups); not one cipher.
Grouped all 110 letters by sign hand on 110-dpi strips; catalogue 1311 split into 18 entries (2628-2645: 17 families + 1 miscellany of 38 singletons); 9 clear leaves excluded.
Family C (R5502-R5506, R5514, R5515, R5517, R5518): automatic sign reader (sforza1597 signreader.py v2), 16,055 glyphs, clustered to 60 and to 35 signs.
CTTS headless, period Italian corpus: 60 clusters 7.31 M vs 6.48 M shuffled (1.13); 35 clusters 7.45 M vs 6.86 M (1.09). No words.
Shuffled-token control run alongside each solve; the real tokens barely beat it.
R5518 transcribed by hand from 3x crops: 563 signs, about 36 types (v2 splits three q-like signs merged in v1).
CTTS on the hand transcription: v1 1.44, v2 1.55 against shuffled; two seeds agree on the key.
Italian phrases read: "mente adoperarme in beneficio del vostra stato", "de cio avisarme", "in ordine ... fornire de le cose necessarie", "in questo paese per carestia".
R5514 transcribed by hand from 3x crops: 1,853 cipher signs, clear passages left out.
Joint CTTS on R5518 + R5514 (2,416 signs): 17.46 M vs 8.67 M shuffled (2.01); two seeds agree.
Dictionary-word share of the decryption (4-12 letters, greedy): R5514 0.51, R5518 0.39, shuffled 0.23.
R5514 reads in stretches: "la qual cosa grandemente ... per adoperar ben del vostro stato", "a roma", "a cremona", "per persone inteligenti", "risposta ... scrito", "secreto".
R5517 transcribed by hand from 3x crops: 1,698 cipher signs.
Out-of-sample: R5517 decrypted with the key solved on R5518 + R5514 only: word share 0.40 vs 0.23 shuffled; reads "la impresa de urbino", "lo mio cancelliero", "conte Iacomo", "risposta".
Joint CTTS on R5518 + R5514 + R5517 (4,114 signs): 16.70 M vs 8.04 M shuffled (2.08); word share 0.42 / 0.48 / 0.42.

Key corrected by hand with R5517 held out: o=a, -=e, w=i, t=o, c=i; 7=q, r=b, 3=g kept against the LM. Segmentation score train -8020 -> -7704, holdout -6760 -> -6335; holdout word share 0.40 -> 0.43.

Sign re-check: "- T" and "- e" are single ligature signs (D1, E). Joint solve 2.11 vs shuffled (was 2.08); D1 = a/la helps both sets slightly; the two theta shapes were not marked consistently, so their split could not be scored.

Box-level transcription by aligning hand tokens to signreader boxes (3,063 of 4,114 tokens aligned); montage check shows about 1 box in 10 is the right sign, so look-alikes cannot be relabelled from it.
Second by-eye pass on look-alikes: "o -" = O (7 merges); barred o split into plain (t) and long-barred (f) on R5514 ll. 4/10/15/24/25 and R5518 l. 9. Word share flat (0.44 / 0.50 / 0.43).

Nomenclator test: signs that are rarely inside words (ct sign, q, P, u, l, w) tried as nulls, letters and word/syllable values; nulls never help, and word values gain for every sign alike (metric bias), so no code sign detected.
Compared the family C key with all 93 key sheets of cart. 1598 and 115 of cart. 1597; several share the a = + habit (R5245, R5255, R5346, R5475) but none fits e = 2, o = 6, i = 4.
R5503 transcribed by hand: 1,551 cipher signs (R5515 too faint to read).

R5503 decrypted out of sample with the key fitted on R5518 + R5514: word share 0.471 vs 0.143 shuffled; reads "conte Iacomo", "acampo a Castiglione", "cinque milia persone", "sigillate le mie litere del mio sigillo".
R5502 transcribed by hand: 2,011 cipher signs.

R5502 decrypted out of sample with the key fitted on R5518 + R5514: word share 0.461 vs 0.140 shuffled; reads "lo conte Iacomo", "Lodovico", "la Mirandola", "la ritornata de ser Cristoforo", "de tutta Italia".
R5506 page 1 transcribed by hand: 1,034 cipher signs.

R5506 decrypted out of sample with the key fitted on R5518 + R5514: word share 0.470 vs 0.164 shuffled; reads "conte Iacomo questo ser Cristoforo suo cancellero", "Baglione ... quatrocento cavalli", "duca de Modena".
R5504 p.1 ll.1-16 (393 signs) decrypted out of sample with the key fitted on R5518 + R5514: word share 0.417 vs 0.102 shuffled.
R5505 p.1 ll.1-16 (439 signs) decrypted out of sample: word share 0.417 vs 0.171 shuffled; reads "de la Mirandola ... ser Cristoforo cancellero ... conte Iacomo".
Joint CTTS on all eight family C letters (9,509 signs): 17.13 M vs 7.18 M shuffled (2.39), seeds agree; solver key 0.476 vs hand key 0.460 word share; only P = i adopted after context checks.
Family B: R5562 transcribed by hand (686 signs, all cipher).
CTTS on R5562: 24.09 M vs 10.73 M shuffled (2.24), seeds agree; decryption reads as continuous Italian (Nicodemo, Iovan Galeasmo, meser Ludovico, Tomasino, Corsica, die quinto decembris).
Dictionary cover of the R5562 decryption with 4+ letter words 0.65 vs 0.26 for shuffled tokens.

Family B key (fitted on R5562 only) applied unchanged to R5576, R5572, R5577, R5575 (part), R5586 (part): 4+ letter word cover 0.60-0.67 vs 0.10-0.17 shuffled; all read as continuous Italian, dated at Sarsane.

Family B complete: R5575 and R5586 finished, R5573 added; all seven letters (4,363 signs) decrypted with keyB.json unchanged, 4+ letter word cover 0.61 overall; reads as dated letters from Sarzana and Florence on messer Ludovico, Tomasino, Corsica, Volterra.

Family B review: 5-gram re-scoring flagged 130 positions; two look-alike merges found (R = r4/rr4, 5/S); 43 emendations applied (editorial, not yet each checked on the image). Strict-segmenter read share 0.893 over all seven letters.
43 flagged signs checked on image crops: R->o (underlined rr4, new sign W) and 5/8->S (h) confirmed, 38 accepted; 5 unconfirmed dropped. Strict read share 0.886.
R5586 lines 7-18 re-read at 2.5x: four corrections (three rr4 = o); remaining unread pieces are paper damage and numeral-like signs. Family B read share 0.887.

outcome.method_basis: R5518 partly decrypted with a key recovered from the ciphertext alone (no external key); about half the text reads, not yet measured.
outcome.notes: Family B (seven letters, cart. 1598 nos. 88-112): one key recovered from the ciphertext alone, read share 0.89 measured. Family C: one key, about 0.47 word share. Other families not started.
